definitions: A style of car drifting originating in Japan, characterized by high-speed, controlled skids through corners.
Often refers to the third installment of The Fast and the Furious film series, 'The Fast and the Furious: Tokyo Drift'.
examples: He mastered the Tokyo Drift on the mountain roads.
The soundtrack for Tokyo Drift was iconic.
They practiced Tokyo Drift maneuvers in the parking lot.
